Family Sharing settings vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's Family Sharing workflow covers language. Connect and iOS actually separate purchase behavior from storefront copy:

  • Family Sharing eligibility — toggled per IAP or subscription in Connect. Controls whether purchases can be shared with up to five family members. Does not generate Chinese text.
  • Shared subscription / family plan — subscription group configuration and pricing. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains shared access to buyers.
  • Ask to Buy — parental purchase approval flow in iOS Settings. Your listing may mention it; implementing the flow is engineering, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Family Sharing flags.

A compliant US listing with Family Sharing enabled and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Family Sharing listing copy vs IAP names vs subscription offers

US/EU indie teams often conflate three string families. This page covers product-page listing copy that markets shared access — not purchase-sheet product IDs or offer deal lines:

  • Listing description & screenshot overlays — paragraphs and frame text explaining "one purchase, up to six family members", "Share with Family", or family-plan value. This page.
  • IAP / subscription product display names — tier titles on the purchase sheet ("Annual Pro", "Family Plan"). Covered on our IAP localization guide — a different Connect row.
  • Subscription offer display copy — intro, promo, win-back deal lines beside a tier ("1 month free", "Save 50%"). Covered on our subscription offer guide — not family-plan marketing paragraphs.

You can localize the tier name and still leave every family-plan screenshot overlay and description paragraph English-only. Buyers then see a Chinese title with English "Share with Family" badges — a mismatch that reads like half-finished localization. What China buyers see when zh-Hans Family Sharing copy is missing

Household purchasers browsing the China App Store evaluate shared-access value in the first scroll. Common failure modes when only en-US is filled:

  • English title and subtitle — app name and tagline still Latin script while competitors show native Chinese family-plan positioning
  • Untranslated family badges on screenshots — overlay lines like "Share with Family", "Family Plan", "Up to 6 members", or "Ask to Buy" remain English on zh-Hans gallery frames
  • Subscription value in English — description opens with US family-marketing ("One subscription for the whole family") that China readers skim past or misread
  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 家庭共享, 家人共享, 家庭版, or 订阅共享; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent
  • Mixed page — Chinese description pasted once but screenshot captions and subtitle still English — reads unfinished next to localized competitors
  • Formal machine translation — stiff 翻译腔 for "Family Sharing" (家庭共享 vs 家人共享 context) and wrong Ask to Buy phrasing that does not match how Chinese parents read store pages

Better zh-Hans listing copy helps household buyers understand shared access before install. It does not replace Family Sharing configuration, Ask to Buy implementation, or Apple's review decisions.

Family Sharing–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Family-plan listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese household buyers describe shared subscriptions — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Share with Family phrasing

US pages use "Share with Family", "Family Sharing", or "One purchase, whole family." China storefront copy often uses 家庭共享, 与家人共享, or 一次购买全家使用 — depending on whether you mean Apple's Family Sharing feature or a generic family plan. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual Connect Family Sharing eligibility, not inventing capabilities your app does not support.

Family plan vs individual tier positioning

Screenshot overlays and description leads reference shared subscription value — one plan for multiple members, shared IAP unlocks, or bundled family access. Chinese buyers expect concrete scope (最多 6 位家人, 一次订阅全家可用) rather than English slogans ("Better together", "Family first").

Ask to Buy mentions

Some listings reference parental purchase approval for child accounts. These are factual product claims in description or screenshot copy — not substitutes for implementing Ask to Buy in iOS, which AppLocale does not engineer.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need family-relevant search terms Chinese household buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 家庭版, 共享订阅, and 家人 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords.

Common mistakes on Family Sharing zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming Family Sharing eligibility localizes automatically — shared IAP flag set; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and screenshot caption lines still English
  • Reusing US "Share with Family" badges verbatim — Latin badges on zh-Hans screenshots signal an unfinished localization
  • Conflating listing copy with Connect configuration — description explains how to enable Family Sharing in Settings instead of what the buyer gets; setup instructions belong in support docs, not AppLocale scope
  • Mixing up IAP display names and listing marketing — "Family Plan" pasted as IAP product name when the listing paragraph should explain shared access; see IAP localization for purchase-sheet strings
  • Ignoring caption fields per localization — zh-Hans screenshot set uploaded but overlay text fields never saved; see Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese
  • Expecting AppLocale to toggle Family Sharing — Connect eligibility, shared subscription setup, and Ask to Buy flows are outside listing rewrite
